text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's like Grandma said, the world of
racing is
special.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, there's an incredible spell
that can
only be used here.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You mean, like, racing magic? That
would be so
cool if it was real!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It is real! If you think it's fake, then you just don't know enough about magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But anyway, don't forget about the
scrimmage
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Copy that! ☆ I'm gonna go full
throttle! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I think you might be in for a
surprise when
you see Sweet Pea run! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You better believe I'll show my
familiar that
I'm a master that's worth
devoting to!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the beginning of Sweep
Tosho's
training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to try a scrimmage right away
to get a
taste of racing magic. I figure
she's bursting with
motivat—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nooo! Freaking! Waaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some of Sweep Tosho's classmates,
Mayano Top
Gun, Biko Pegasus, and
Nishino Flower, stand
around her while
she throws a fit.
choice_data_list: （あれー？）

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's it! I don't wanna run with anyone
anymore!
I'm outta here!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see what happened! A young girl's
heart is
complicated, Trainer! ☆
choice_data_list: でも模擬レースをするんじゃ……？

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Try thinking back to what you said just
before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think back to when Sweep Tosho
introduced
everyone to me earlier.
choice_data_list: さっき……？

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heyo! ☆ Let's have a good race
today! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun, known for her
versatile running
style, and two
dedicated sprinters showed up for

today's scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. They adjusted the distance for
us this
time, so it'll be a 1,000-meter
race today...
choice_data_list: まさに一線級の子たちだ……！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower specializes in sprints.
She's a
genius who showed her prowess
earlier than most
and gained early
admittance to Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Raaaaah! I'm all fired up! Time to warm
up!
choice_data_list: 逆に君たちと競える機会なんて貴重だよ！
逆に貴方たちと競える機会なんて貴重だよ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Biko Pegasus. She's an inspiring
student
determined to take on any
opponent, no matter
how strong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Racing Biko Pegasus is sure to benefit
Sweep
Tosho. At least, that's what I'm
thinking, when...
choice_data_list: 彼女のような根性が手に入ったら……！

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nnngh, hey! You know that you're my familiar, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ugh! You big idiot!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Dumb, stupid familiar! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Sweet Pea?! What's wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before there's any time to stop her,
Sweep Tosho
runs straight off the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She disappears in the blink of an eye,
just like a
shooting star. Her speed and
acceleration are
incredible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no question—she has a hidden
potential
unlike anyone else.
choice_data_list: 魔法みたいだ……

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
What are you spacing out for?! Go after
her!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's obvious that you two are a great pair.
Plus,
there's no need for you to worry
about us.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So just go get Sweep, okay?! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mayano Top Gun and the others
urge me
to go looking for Sweep Tosho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I finally find her in the library!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph! Stupid familiar! Later, dummy!
choice_data_list: 見つけた、スイープっ！！

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uh, um... Are you two fighting? You and
Sweep, I
mean.
choice_data_list: 待って！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
(This is Zenno Rob Roy. She's in her
classic year
and good friends with Sweep
Tosho.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see. So... she ran off before the
scrimmage with
her friends, and now
you're here...
choice_data_list: ああ、実は――
その、実は――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. You can't hide that sparkle in
your eye.
choice_data_list: その時の彼女の脚も、本当に速くて……！

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
From a certain point of view, arrogance
is purity.
And so, as a servant to my
king, I too must serve
with purity.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, um... It's from a book! That is...
choice_data_list: 傲慢さとは純粋さ？

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Listening to what you said just now... I
thought it
would be best to be direct
with her. ...What do
you think?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What do you want?
choice_data_list: 純粋に今の気持ちを……

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! What's with you all of a
sudden?!
choice_data_list: 俺は君がすごいって思ったんだ
私は貴方がすごいって思ったんだ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her my honest feelings from today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I saw who was running in the
scrimmage, I
thought racing them was
going to be a great
opportunity for
Sweep Tosho's future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when she stormed off, I couldn't
help but be
captivated by the talent she
displayed.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: 君の走りは魔法みたいだって思ったんだ
貴方の走りは魔法みたいだって思ったの

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Are you stupid?! Did you think I'd be
happy just
because you say I'm magical?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But... if you really think that...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Familiar! I'm gonna run one
more time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sweep Tosho runs one more lap.
When I
see her running so comfortably
at such an
incredible speed, I can only
think...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. Not "like" magic!
choice_data_list: やっぱり魔法みたいな走りだ……！
やっぱり魔法みたいな走り……！

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm Magical Girl Sweepy, the one
destined to
discover the real magic spell
for racing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But I warn you... racing magic isn't easy
to find! It
takes determination.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma also told me I wouldn't be able
to find it
unless I run in a bunch of real
races.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And since you're my familiar, you've
gotta devote
yourself to me and me
alone!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Until I discover the racing spell, I need
you to put
me first! You can't be
focusing on anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So yeah... Just in case. I don't think
there's any
way this actually happens,
but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
On the off chance you do see someone
better
than me... you still need to
compliment me first!
Not her! Got that?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's sealed, then! This is a pact with your
master,
so don't you dare forget!
choice_data_list: わかった！

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now, go get Mayano and the others
back here.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Familiars are supposed to be
dedicated to
their masters! You've
already got a chance to be
useful, so
give it everything you've got!
choice_data_list: えっ！？

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you say that running a scrimmage
with
them would be good for my future?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, my journey as an overworked
familiar for
a demanding magical girl on
a quest for racing
magic has officially
begun!
